You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From c61f30a255550bbfc6b83c1ca720661489cac4c0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2015 11:51:36 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] ARM: dts: armadillo800eva Correct extal1 frequency to 24 MHz

On r8a7740/armadillo, actual clock rates are ca. 4% lower than reported
by /sys/kernel/debug/clk/clk_summary. Correct the extal1 frequency from
25 MHz to 24 MHz to fix this.

This matches the Armadillo-800 EVA Product Manual, which claims the main
crystal runs at 24 MHz, and the old legacy/reference board code.

Fixes: 25aa7ba3fdfb ("ARM: shmobile: armadillo800eva: Sync DTS")
Signed-off-by: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Signed-off-by: Simon Horman <horms+renesas@verge.net.au>
---
 arch/arm/boot/dts/r8a7740-armadillo800eva.dts | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/arch/arm/boot/dts/r8a7740-armadillo800eva.dts b/arch/arm/boot/dts/r8a7740-armadillo800eva.dts
index 105d9c95de4a..5c76dcc89df5 100644
--- a/arch/arm/boot/dts/r8a7740-armadillo800eva.dts
+++ b/arch/arm/boot/dts/r8a7740-armadillo800eva.dts
@@ -180,7 +180,7 @@ phy0: ethernet-phy@0 {
 };
 
 &extal1_clk {
-	clock-frequency = <25000000>;
+	clock-frequency = <24000000>;
 };
 &extal2_clk {
 	clock-frequency = <48000000>;
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The root cause of the bug was an incorrect clock frequency value specified for the extal1 clock in the device tree source (DTS) file for the Armadillo-800 EVA platform. The frequency was set to 25 MHz, which was inconsistent with the actual frequency of the main crystal, which is 24 MHz as per the product manual. This discrepancy led to clock rates being approximately 4% lower than reported, causing potential issues in timing and performance of the system. The patch corrected the frequency to the accurate value of 24 MHz.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>

The frequency was set to 25 MHz, which was inconsistent with the actual frequency of the main crystal, which is 24 MHz as per the product manual. This discrepancy led to clock rates being approximately 4% lower than reported, causing potential issues in timing and performance of the system. The patch corrected the frequency to the accurate value of 24 MHz.
